newsitem.title: UK: Wessex Water share tender undersubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Wessex Water share tender undersubscribed.

text.p: British water and sewerage firm Wessex Water Plc said it had received tenders for around 3.2 percent of its shares after offering up to 10.5 percent.
The offer, which closed on January 24, was made in conjunction with a plan to repurchase all B shares and C shares and 10 percent of its ordinary shares held by Waste Management International.
The company said in a statement that subject to shareholder approval, the total reduction in voting share capital would be around 19.6 percent.
Wessex launched the tender offer to shareholders on December 18 at 380 pence per share.
It said it would pay Waste Management International 355 pence per share.
